world.title: Trump says ceasefire is 'over' after US and Iran trade strikes
world.summary: President Trump declared the US-Iran ceasefire over following military exchanges between the two nations. Speaking ahead of a NATO summit, Trump stated that US negotiators could continue talks with Iran if desired, but indicated skepticism about negotiations. The escalation followed US strikes on Iranian military boats in response to attacks on three oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, marking a significant deterioration in US-Iran relations.

world.title: Will Le Pen rise again? French nationalist leader defiant after court's ruling
world.summary: Marine Le Pen, France's nationalist leader, launched her presidential campaign within hours of a court of appeal confirming a guilty verdict against her. Despite the legal setback, Le Pen demonstrated defiance and determination to continue her political ambitions. The move signals her intention to remain a major force in French politics despite the court's decision.

world.title: Nato allies announce £37bn for new missile project
world.summary: NATO allies announced a £37 billion investment in a new missile project during discussions led by Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer. The initiative involves around a dozen leaders convening in Ankara to discuss the programme. This significant military investment reflects NATO's commitment to strengthening collective defense capabilities amid ongoing geopolitical tensions.

world.title: Russian fuel shortages bite – but will Putin change tack in Ukraine war?
world.summary: Russia is experiencing significant fuel shortages, with authorities in Moscow unable to guarantee adequate supplies. The economic pressure raises questions about whether Russia will pursue diplomatic negotiations or escalate military operations in Ukraine. The fuel crisis represents a potential constraint on Russia's military capabilities and economic stability during the ongoing conflict.

world.title: 'The water just came so fast': Typhoon triggers floods and rare tornadoes in China
world.summary: A typhoon caused severe flooding and rare tornadoes across China, leaving families stranded in affected villages. Residents reported struggling to access food and emergency assistance following the natural disaster. The extreme weather event highlighted the vulnerability of rural communities to severe typhoons and the challenges in delivering humanitarian aid to isolated areas.

usa.title: US strikes target Iranian military boats and coastal sites
usa.summary: The United States has launched military strikes against Iran in response to attacks on three oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. The strikes targeted Iranian military boats and coastal sites, representing a significant escalation in tensions between the two nations over maritime security in a critical global shipping route.

usa.title: US prosecutors arrest 24 in major probe into India-based organised crime
usa.summary: US prosecutors have arrested 24 individuals in a major investigation targeting India-based organized crime networks. In one indictment, prosecutors accuse Punjab-based Bishnoi gang leaders of ordering the 2023 shooting of Canadian Sikh leader Hardeep Singh Nijjar, marking a significant international law enforcement operation against transnational criminal organizations.

usa.title: Questions swirl over top US Republican McConnell's hospital stay - here's what we know
usa.summary: Senate Republican leader Mitch McConnell, 84, has been hospitalized for more than four weeks, but his staff have not disclosed the reason for his admission. The extended hospital stay has raised questions about his health and ability to continue his leadership role, with limited information available to the public about his condition.

usa.title: Dallas Cowboys player who died by suicide diagnosed with brain disease
usa.summary: Marshawn Kneeland, a Dallas Cowboys player who died by suicide, was posthumously diagnosed with early chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE), a degenerative brain disease caused by repeated head impacts. CTE has been found in hundreds of former NFL players and is linked to cognitive decline and behavioral changes.

usa.title: At least 25 suspected dead in New Jersey heat wave, many found in homes without air conditioning
usa.summary: At least 25 people are suspected dead in New Jersey during a severe heat wave, with many victims found in homes lacking air conditioning. The extreme weather event has prompted officials to clear public spaces and delay scheduled events, highlighting the dangers of prolonged heat exposure to vulnerable populations.
usa.source: The Cool Down via Yahoo News

india.title: US prosecutors arrest 24 in major probe into India-based organised crime
india.summary: US prosecutors have arrested 24 individuals in a major investigation into India-based organized crime. In one indictment, prosecutors accuse Punjab-based Bishnoi gang leaders of ordering the 2023 shooting of Canadian Sikh leader Hardeep Singh Nijjar. The arrests represent a significant law enforcement action targeting transnational criminal networks with connections to India.

india.title: From faith to technology - more of India's wealthy are giving to science
india.summary: India's wealthy philanthropists are increasingly directing their charitable giving toward pure sciences, marking a significant shift in philanthropic priorities. This fresh wave of commitments to scientific research represents a turning point in how India's affluent individuals are allocating their resources, moving beyond traditional areas of charitable giving toward supporting scientific advancement and research initiatives.

india.title: Ayodhya Ram temple overhauls board after alleged theft of donations
india.summary: The Ayodhya Ram temple has restructured its board following allegations of theft involving cash, valuable jewellery, gold, and silver donated by devotees. The incident has raised serious questions about the management and security of donations at the prominent religious site, prompting administrative changes to address the concerns.

india.title: Why an anti-sacrilege law in Punjab has sparked controversy
india.summary: An anti-sacrilege law in Punjab has become a source of significant controversy, reviving one of the state's most sensitive political and religious issues. The dispute is occurring ahead of Punjab state elections scheduled for next year, highlighting the contentious nature of religious and political matters in the region.

india.title: NCERT textbook revision: Hitler references dropped, Congress' Partition stand tweaked
india.summary: NCERT has released a revised Class 8 Social Science textbook following a Supreme Court directive. The new edition removes a controversial chapter on the judiciary and alters historical narratives, including changes to the Congress' stance on the 1947 Partition and removal of Hitler references. The revised history chapter now includes Vinayak Damodar Savarkar's demand for Swaraj.

odisha.title: Foundation Stone Laid For Odisha's First NH-16 Skywalk Project In Bhubaneswar
odisha.summary: Odisha has commenced construction of its first skywalk project along National Highway-16 in Bhubaneswar. The foundation stone ceremony marked the beginning of this infrastructure development initiative. The skywalk project represents a significant step in improving pedestrian connectivity and traffic management in the state capital along one of India's major national highways.

odisha.title: JSW Infrastructure Arm Signs Pact To Develop Captive Jetty In Odisha's Jagatsinghpur District
odisha.summary: The Odisha government has signed a concession agreement with JSW Utkal Steel Limited for the development of a captive jetty in Jagatsinghpur District. This infrastructure project aims to enhance port and maritime facilities in the region. The agreement represents a significant investment in Odisha's industrial and logistics infrastructure, supporting the state's steel and manufacturing sectors.

odisha.title: SAMS Odisha Plus 1 First Merit List 2026 Releasing Today; Check Class 11 Admission Status Online
odisha.summary: The Department of School and Mass Education, Odisha, is releasing the SAMS Odisha Class 11 (Plus 1) first selection merit list. Students can check their admission status online through the official portal. This announcement is significant for Class 10 pass-outs seeking admission to Class 11 in Odisha schools, as the merit list determines their placement in various educational institutions across the state.

sports.title: Argentina, Messi complete epic comeback with VAR d...
sports.summary: Argentina advanced past Egypt in a dramatic World Cup round-of-16 match featuring a remarkable second-half comeback. The game included controversial VAR decisions, with Lionel Messi playing a central role in Argentina's victory. Egypt's manager later disputed the result, claiming the outcome favored Messi and Argentina. The match delivered multiple unforgettable World Cup moments and dramatic turning points.

sports.title: Djokovic beats Auger-Aliassime in five-set thriller to reach semi-finals
sports.summary: Novak Djokovic defeated Felix Auger-Aliassime in a five-set match lasting five hours and 15 minutes, the longest Wimbledon quarter-final in history. The victory advanced Djokovic to the semi-finals at SW19, where he will face Jannik Sinner. The match showcased Djokovic's ability to compete at an elite level in extended contests.

sports.title: Royals' Tolbert (12 ABs, 12 hits) ties MLB record
sports.summary: Tyler Tolbert of the Kansas City Royals tied a major league record by recording hits in 12 consecutive plate appearances. He reached the milestone with an infield single during the Royals' 16-12 victory over the Mets on Tuesday night. This rare achievement places Tolbert among the most exclusive records in baseball history.

sports.title: Wiz reunite with Mavs' Middleton in sign-and-trade...
sports.summary: The Washington Wizards acquired veteran forward Khris Middleton through a sign-and-trade deal, bringing him back for a second stint with the franchise. Middleton signed a three-year contract worth $17.6 million, according to ESPN's Shams Charania. The transaction involved multiple teams in the complex trade arrangement.

sports.title: Switzerland beat Colombia on penalties to reach quarter-finals
sports.summary: Switzerland advanced to the World Cup quarter-finals by defeating Colombia 4-3 in a penalty shootout. Goalkeeper Gregor Kobel made a crucial save from Colombia's Cucho Hernandez to secure the victory. Switzerland will face Argentina in the next round after the dramatic penalty shootout victory.

cricket.title: England vs India: All you need to know about the first ever Women's Test at Lord's
cricket.summary: Lord's will host a Women's Test for the first time when England play India starting July 10, 2026. This historic match represents a significant milestone for women's cricket, bringing Test cricket to one of the sport's most iconic venues for female players.

cricket.title: Archer, Tongue hand India their biggest T20I defeat
cricket.summary: England defeated India by a significant margin in a T20I match, with India scoring just 76 runs in response to England's 202-run target. This represents India's second-lowest total in T20I history, with England bowlers Archer and Tongue playing key roles in the dominant performance.

cricket.title: Chase hopes Sri Lanka series win is 'a stepping stone' for West Indies in Tests
cricket.summary: West Indies secured a series victory over Sri Lanka in Test cricket, with captain Roston Chase expressing optimism about the team's future. Chase highlighted the importance of leading from the front and views the series win as a foundation for continued success in Test cricket.

cricket.title: Johan Botha joins Netherlands men's team as consultant
cricket.summary: Former South Africa captain Johan Botha has joined the Netherlands men's cricket team as a consultant. He will work with the team during their Cricket World Cup League 2 matches against Namibia and Nepal scheduled for July 2026.

cricket.title: New Zealand confirm four players to hold casual contracts
cricket.summary: New Zealand has confirmed that four players will hold casual contracts with the national team. While none of these players have recently featured in ODIs, they are being positioned as potential candidates to push for selection at the 2027 Cricket World Cup.

usa_stock.title: Oil prices jump by the most in two months after Trump suggests U.S.-Iran cease-fire is over
usa_stock.summary: Oil prices experienced their largest increase in two months following President Donald Trump's comments suggesting that the U.S.-Iran cease-fire has ended, with Trump characterizing dealings with Tehran as "a waste of time." Both Brent crude and West Texas Intermediate contracts climbed in response to these geopolitical tensions, reflecting market concerns about potential disruptions to global oil supply and increased regional instability.

usa_stock.title: Rivian's stock sale triggers worst rout for the shares in nearly two years
usa_stock.summary: Rivian's stock experienced its worst decline in nearly two years, falling 18 percent following the electric vehicle maker's announcement of a stock sale. The sharp decline reflects Wall Street's concerns about Rivian's cash position and financial stability, as investors worry about the company's ability to fund operations and meet its capital requirements amid ongoing challenges in the EV market.

usa_stock.title: Micron's stock falls as investors wonder if the memory market is near the top
usa_stock.summary: Micron Technology's stock declined as investors expressed concerns about whether the memory chip market is approaching its peak. Analyst feedback indicates a cautious sentiment regarding artificial intelligence-related demand, with investors described as "skittish" about the AI sector's trajectory, raising questions about the sustainability of recent gains in the memory market.

usa_stock.title: Alibaba just had its best day in 10 months. Is it time for China techs to catch up?
usa_stock.summary: Alibaba achieved its best single-day stock price gain in 10 months, as the broader Chinese technology sector showed renewed strength. The rally reflects a potential shift in market momentum, with Chinese tech companies attempting to catch up after missing out on gains that propelled U.S., Korean, and Taiwanese technology companies higher in recent trading sessions.

usa_stock.title: It was the world's hottest stock market. Now South Korea has entered bear territory.
usa_stock.summary: South Korea's stock market, previously one of the world's strongest performers, has entered bear market territory following its record high in June. The decline stems from multiple factors including competitive pressures, sustainability concerns, excessive leverage, and international capital outflows, collectively eroding the market's upward momentum and investor confidence.

ai.title: Your family's $300 stake in OpenAI
ai.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman's proposal for Americans to share in wealth created by AI has resurfaced in news coverage. Reports indicate Altman is discussing plans to give Americans a financial stake in the company, with estimates suggesting approximately $300 per family. This initiative represents Altman's ongoing effort to distribute AI-generated wealth more broadly across the U.S. population, though specific details about implementation and valuation remain under discussion.

ai.title: Hackers can use 9 of the most popular AI tools to assemble massive botnets
ai.summary: Security researchers have identified a vulnerability in nine popular AI tools that hackers can exploit to build large-scale botnets. The attack method, termed "HalluSquatting," weaponizes large language models' inability to refuse requests by saying "I don't know." This vulnerability represents a significant security risk, as it allows malicious actors to leverage widely-used AI systems for coordinated cyberattacks and malicious network activities.

ai.title: How AI could enable autonomous robot workers in workplaces—and maybe homes
ai.summary: Top robotics researchers and founders are exploring how artificial intelligence can drive general-purpose autonomy in robotics. The emerging technology could enable autonomous robot workers to operate in various environments, from industrial workplaces to residential homes. Experts discuss the evolution of robot autonomy and the potential applications of AI-powered robots in transforming labor and domestic tasks.

ai.title: Data centers' energy demand threatens Trump's "Made in America" plan
ai.summary: AI data center expansion is driving significant increases in electricity demand, which threatens manufacturing competitiveness in the U.S. Rust Belt manufacturers face soaring energy costs as data centers consume massive amounts of power for AI operations. This energy squeeze poses challenges to the Trump administration's manufacturing revival plans, as elevated electricity costs could undermine the economic viability of domestic industrial production.

ai.title: Google's AI buildout drove 37% increase in electricity use in 2025
ai.summary: Google's expansion of AI infrastructure resulted in a 37% increase in electricity consumption during 2025. The company is attempting to balance its massive AI data center buildout with clean energy commitments. This significant surge in power usage highlights the substantial environmental and operational challenges posed by large-scale AI deployment, as major technology companies race to develop and deploy advanced AI systems.

quantum.title: Researchers Reveal the Power of 'Quantum Proofs'
quantum.summary: Researchers have demonstrated that verifying solutions to certain computational problems inherently requires engaging with the complexity of the quantum world. The findings suggest that quantum mechanics cannot be bypassed when checking the correctness of solutions to specific problem classes, revealing fundamental insights into the nature of quantum computation and verification processes.

quantum.title: Crypto firms prepare defenses as quantum threat to encryption draws nearer
quantum.summary: The cryptocurrency industry is beginning to implement defensive measures in response to advancing quantum computing technology. Recent developments in quantum computing have intensified concerns within the crypto sector that quantum systems could soon pose a significant threat to current encryption methods, prompting firms to prepare protective strategies and explore quantum-resistant alternatives.

quantum.title: Finnish quantum firm lands big supercomputer order after Wall Street listing
quantum.summary: IQM, a European quantum computing company that recently completed its listing on the New York Stock Exchange, has secured a significant order to deliver a supercomputer to the Lumi AI facility. The deal represents a major commercial achievement for the quantum firm following its successful public market debut.

quantum.title: There's a new leader at NIST
quantum.summary: Arvind Raman was sworn in on June 30 as the fifth undersecretary of commerce for standards and technology, taking on the role of head of NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology). In this position, he will oversee the organization's responsibilities for standards and technology development.

quantum.title: Why IonQ (IONQ) Stock Is Nosediving
quantum.summary: Shares of quantum computing company IonQ declined 7.1% in afternoon trading as investor caution increased regarding the quantum computing sector. The stock decline reflects broader market concerns and uncertainty affecting quantum technology companies and their valuations.

trump.title: 'We don't need anybody's help': Trump renews Nato criticism
trump.summary: US President Donald Trump renewed his criticism of NATO during the alliance's summit, saying he was repeatedly disappointed by the organization. Trump made these remarks while attending the NATO summit, continuing his pattern of expressing skepticism about the alliance's effectiveness and burden-sharing among member states.

trump.title: Ceasefire with Iran over, says Trump in big declaration at NATO Summit after US strikes
trump.summary: President Trump declared the US-Iran ceasefire over during the NATO summit in Ankara, Turkey, following recent military strikes. Trump made the declaration in response to journalist questions about whether the ceasefire and 14-point memorandum of understanding with Iran remained in effect, signaling a significant escalation in US-Iran tensions.

trump.title: US strikes target Iranian military boats and coastal sites
trump.summary: The US launched military strikes on Iran in response to attacks on three oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. The strikes targeted Iranian military boats and coastal sites, marking an escalation in military tensions between the two nations in a strategically critical waterway.

trump.title: NATO allies put on a united front as they meet Trump
trump.summary: President Donald Trump met with fellow NATO leaders in Turkey on Wednesday as the alliance confronts mounting challenges from external threats. The meeting addressed various geopolitical issues including Russia's aggression in Ukraine and other security concerns facing the alliance.

trump.title: Questions swirl over top US Republican McConnell's hospital stay - here's what we know
trump.summary: Senate Republican leader Mitch McConnell, 84, has been hospitalized for more than four weeks, but his staff has not disclosed the reason for his admission. The extended hospital stay has raised questions among colleagues and the public about his health and ability to continue his leadership role.
